The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the GTBH Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 29-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of GTBH Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital Delhi (GTBH Delhi) to fill vacant healthcare positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 89 vacancies available for the Senior Resident Doctors posts in various departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts available in this recruitment drive are Senior Resident Doctors across multiple medical and surgical specialties.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and de-activation of the Google Form link is 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for GTBH Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes filling out the online Google form, document verification, and an interview conducted by the Selection Board.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years, with eligible age relaxations provided for reserved categories like SC, ST, and OBC.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Senior Resident Doctors?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 67,700/- + NPA in Pay Level 11 along with other applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 500/- for UR and OBC candidates, while SC, ST, PH, and EWS candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q9. When are the interviews scheduled?
faq.answer: The interviews for departments 1 to 9 are scheduled for 30 September 2026, and for departments 10 to 19, they are scheduled for 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by filling out the Google form link provided in the notification before the deadline and bringing the printout with documents to the interview.
